sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 197 x 151 x 41 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Shure QLX-D user guide (downloaded and read as text 2026-11-12): the receiver has an XLR audio output, a 1/4 in instrument / auxiliary output, an Ethernet port, BNC antenna connectors and a DC power supply jack (external PS24 supply, so no mains inlet and no power control). Modelled: XLR out, 1/4 in out, Ethernet (aoip, a control and scanning port, takes no audio route); the BNC antennas and the DC jack have no signal type and are not ports. Size 197 x 151 x 41 mm ("41 H x 197 W x 151 D", the guide), receiver only: the transmitters are separate devices. Positions are guesses (the guide says "rear"); same layout as the SLX-D receiver.
